title: Motion for an extension of time to file respondent's brief on the merits

pages.text:
Gupta Wessler LLP
235 Montgomery Street, Suite 629, San Francisco, CA 94104
P 415 573 0336     F 202 888 7792
guptawessler.com

December 5, 2025

Via Electronic Filing

Hon. Scott S. Harris
Clerk of the Court
Supreme Court of the United States
One First Street, NE
Washington, DC 20543










Re: No. 24-935, Flower Foods, Inc. et al. v. Brock

Dear Mr. Harris:

 I write to respectfully request that the Court extend the deadline for the respondent,
Angelo Brock, to file his response brief on the merits. The brief is currently due on January 5,
2026. The respondent requests a  seven-day extension, to and including January 12, 2026. The
petitioner consents to this request.

 Good cause for this extension exists because I have several obligations that would make
it difficult for me and my colleagues to prepare the response brief absent a one-week extension.
These include: an opening brief due in the Ninth Circuit in Lang v. Providence Health Services,
No. 25-7294, on December 29, 2025; and an oral argument in the Ninth Circuit in People of the
State of California v. Meta Platforms, Inc., No. 24-7037, on January 6, 2026.

 Oral argument in this case has not yet been set. This extension would permit the case to
be heard during any of the remaining sittings.

       Sincerely,

       /s/ Jennifer D. Bennett
Jennifer D. Bennett
       Counsel for Respondent
